name: alert
description: A short message that needs attention: status, success, warning, or error. Not for long content.

title.description: Optional short title shown in bold before the message.

a11y.role: status for info and success, alert for warning and danger

wcag.notes: Kind is conveyed by a text prefix as well as colour (1.4.1). Warning and danger use role=alert so assistive tech announces them when inserted live.

machine.identify: Read data-kind for the severity and the text content for the message.
machine.operate: Not interactive. Errors from the system are surfaced here; read them before retrying.

props.title: Could not reach the model
props.message: Connection refused at http://localhost:11434. Start Ollama or change llm.base_url in workspace.yaml.

props.title: No model connected
props.message: Edit the llm section of workspace.yaml and restart.
